data.description: Disgusting to behold, the smell of these creatures is a strong clue as to their diet.
data.name: Carrion Slug

data.description: Created from metal parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
data.name: Golem

data.description: A hardy warrior trained for combat.  A true asset to the king.
data.name: Cavalry Trooper

data.description: A true leader of men.  Trusted with the task of keeping the troops in line and loyal to the king.
data.name: Cavalry Officer

data.description: Above average in both skill and size.
data.name: Goblin Champion

data.description: Pressed into service to pay off depts, these troops are not much of a match for those skilled with weapons.
data.name: Royal Soldier

data.description: A snake of unbelievable size.  Easily  60 feet in length and as large around as a full-grown bull vusk.
data.name: Mammoth Snake

data.description: Somewhat skilled with weapons.  The preferred weapon is the bow.
data.name: Royal Corporal

data.description: A hardy warrior trained for combat among the trees.
data.name: Forest knight

data.description: Not a true dragon.  Named after their ilk for it is the only beast known that can rival them in brute strength.
data.name: Dragon Lizard

data.description: A true leader of men.  Trusted with  keeping the troops in line.
data.name: Forest Knight Commander

data.description: Big as a thespian devil cat and twice as mean.  These men are solely paid to keep the troops in line.  They use force if necessary.
data.name: Royal Sergeant

data.description: In life, a formerly valiant warrior. In death, he is now a cursed pawn of evil.
data.name: Skeletal Guardian

data.description: A would be leader of men.  Most die in battle at the hands of their own men if they are not careful.
data.name: Royal Lieutenant

data.description: An experienced leader with the respect of his troops.  Few will question his orders.
data.name: Royal Captain

data.description: Filthy claws and teeth make this creature a deadly menace.  Fear it's bite for it can paralize.
data.name: Flesh Fiend

data.description: Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.
data.name: Skeletal Warrior

data.description: A common vermin of immense size.
data.name: Monstrous Rat

data.description: An apparition from beyond the grave.  Neither good nor evil by nature, it is still best to avoid such creatures.
data.name: Ghost

data.description: An apparition from beyond the grave and extremely evil by nature.  It's good pactice to stay clear of these whispy creatures.
data.name: Spectre

data.description: Large and fierce, this race of giants is evil through and through.
data.name: Frost Giant

data.description: Usually a spirit bound to protect a place; such entities are quite powerful.
data.name: Guardian Soul

data.description: A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your courage.
data.name: Mummy

data.description: Large and fierce, this race of giants is evil through and through.
data.name: Fire Giant

data.description: Power-hungry, he will let nothing prevent him to grow in power and knowledge.
data.name: Master Enchanter

data.description: Common in some areas of cold climate.  No dragon in the Realmz can match this breed when it comes to having a heart of pure evil.
data.name: Ice Dragon

data.description: A lone adventurer of the Underearth.
data.name: Sshrisk

data.description: Old crypts are the favorite haunt of these foul vermin.
data.name: Barrow Troll

data.description: A close cousin to the red dragon.  These creatures are more common in the Abyss than on the material plane.
data.name: Fire Drake

data.description: They sport a nasty chemical attack.  Oh, I guess it may be worth mentioning.  They may split into smaller slimes when killed.
data.name: Slime

data.description: Olive Slime.   Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn.
data.name: Olive Slime

data.description: This most beguiling of demons preys on the sexual impulses of mortals.  Taking the shape of a beautiful man or woman, they lure unsuspecting souls to their doom.
data.name: Succubus

data.description: A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
data.name: Giant Spider

data.description: Also known as necromancers, these sorcerers delve into the dark arts of necromancy. They usually worship Orcas, God of Horrors and Undeath.
data.name: Necrowizard

data.description: A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
data.name: Zombie

data.description: Another one of those unnatural beasts roaming the world.
data.name: Vulg Wolf

data.description: Strongest of the good dragons.  This race of dragon kind devotes their entire lives to the destruction of their evil kin.
data.name: Gold Dragon

data.description: Living on the frigid planes of the Abyss or in remote snowy wastes, this vile race will attack any goodly race on sight.
data.name: Frigid Giant

data.description: Pawns of the frost giants.  These weak-minded fools often do the bidding of the giants and fight by their side.
data.name: Snow Yeti

data.description: They stand 16 feet at the shoulder. These gargantuan humanoids roam mountain passes of every climate.
data.name: Rock Giant

data.description: Souls that have been damned to roam the astral plane.  If provoked, they can exist on the material plane for short periods.
data.name: Wraith

data.description: These beasts are often no more than slaves to the frost giants.  They serve as hands for those that have none.  They are immensly strong.
data.name: Ice Ogre

data.description: Another variant of the troll race, yet every bit as dangerous and vicious.
data.name: Cave Troll

data.description: An evil race of Ogre that has great malice for any surface dwelling race.
data.name: Dark Ogre

data.description: Harpies are considered among the most evil minded of creatures.
data.name: Harpy

data.description: Lurker of sewers, it grabs victims with its powerful tentacles, snaring them for the kill with its bite.
data.name: Sewer Beast

data.description: Evil incarnate, these creatures feast of the terror and pain of those they choose as victims.
data.name: Shadow Wraith

data.description: A gaping maw of immense size makes this mindless foe one to  avoid.
data.name: Purple Worm

data.description: These dragons are a mix of red and green dragons.
data.name: Brown Dragon

data.description: A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
data.name: Orc

data.description: A golem of some type, created to protect or guard areas (or treasures).
data.name: Guardian Warrior

data.description: The chiefson of the minotaur tribe of the Western Lands.
data.name: Grundar

data.description: A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
data.name: Mercenary Soldier

data.description: A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often reenlist to become corporals.
data.name: Mercenary Corporal

data.description: Charged to keep the troops in line.
data.name: Mercenary Sergeant

data.description: Abused as youngsters, these ill- tempered men are but common thugs for hire.
data.name: Mercenary Villain

data.description: Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and coming officer.
data.name: Mercenary Captain
